The narrow lock-scope correction changes no Content public contract, Broker, BudgetService, Auth handler, ledger, model, migration, Provider, endpoint, deploy, release, or product correction. Its regression remains in the already-approved Export runtime test path.

provider_reader_cancellation_manifest_am.source: controller technical direction under the user's standing authorization to make reasonable implementation decisions
provider_reader_cancellation_manifest_am.scope: Add existing backend/internal/backupasset/provider/restic.go and backend/internal/backupasset/provider/runner_test.go to the exact future modify manifest. The shared boundedReadHandle holds its mutex across an underlying Read, while Close must first acquire that mutex before it can close the underlying reader; a truly blocked Provider Read therefore defeats the already-approved Export drain-before-key/source-cleanup invariant. Narrow the internal lock scope and prove Close reaches the underlying reader. This changes no Provider public contract, Provider bytes/locators/credentials, Content public contract, ledger, Broker, BudgetService, Auth handler, model, migration, endpoint, deploy, release, or product correction.
